findings.title: Null delegate handling still incomplete for subgroup stream methods
findings.body: The PR fixes getSubGroupsCount() by guarding a null result from modelSupplier.get(), but the three getSubGroupsStream overloads at lines 256, 262, and 268 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. Since getGroupModel() can return null when the group is deleted concurrently, which is the exact scenario this PR addresses, these overloads will still throw NullPointerException. Apply the same null-handling strategy consistently, e.g. return Stream.empty() or delegate for update.

findings.title: Reader thread is not joined before asserting no exceptions
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread and then sets deletedAll to true and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty without joining the thread. A request that was already in flight when deletedAll was set can fail after the assertion reads the list, so the test can pass even though the NPE it is meant to catch occurred. Additionally, if group removal throws before deletedAll is set, the non-daemon reader thread will loop forever and can outlive the test, interfering with cleanup and other tests. Join the thread before asserting and ensure the stop flag is set in a finally block.
